Platform capabilities

Logmind leverages AI and machine learning to automatically detect, correlate and proactively troubleshoot complex IT problems

Smarter, faster insights

Automatically uncover hidden issues

Logmind automatically detects in real-time the early signals of hidden issues in your millions of log and event streams, using advanced machine learning techniques.

Get a complete picture of your IT issues

Auto correlation of insights allows a better awareness of errors from the earliest stage so as to have enough time to act and avoid major impacts.

Receive automatic solution recommendations

Logmind leverages public knowledge from quality and validated sources to automatically provide solutions to complex issues.

Boosted productivity

Receive prioritized, real-time alerts

Be immediately informed through your favorite channels when critical smart insights are generated. Further integrate with your ITSM ticketing system.

Streamline teamwork to gain in productivity

Collaborate seamlessly to solve issues as soon as they are identified. Invite team members and manage permissions on the team level.

Speak the same language across teams

The common, simple interface keeps team members on the same page. Define visualizations and dashboards according to your specific needs.

Effortless deployment

Get value immediately, without configuration effort

Quickly start using Logmind thanks to its out-of-the-box cloud set-up and intuitive interface. Stay flexible and scale as your needs grow.

Centralize and analyze data from all sources

Logmind is not limited to any log type or format. The ML engine will automatically parse and analyze the data, regardless of its format. Simply decide what you want to push to Logmind and get immediate results.

Easy to use with an intuitive interface

Results are provided as soon as your data is streamed to Logmind. The insights and interface are easy to work with, ensuring immediate adoption by your team.
